name: What safety considerations are important for fire pit use?

mainEntity.name: What safety considerations are important for fire pit use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key fire pit safety considerations include maintaining a clear area of at least 10 feet around the pit, using a spark screen for wood-burning pits, and keeping a water source or extinguisher nearby. Always supervise children and pets, and never use flammable liquids to start a fire. Ensure the fire is completely extinguished before leaving it unattended. For gas fire pits, regularly check for gas leaks and ensure proper ventilation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain a clear area around the fire pit, use spark screens, have water/extinguisher ready, and supervise children/pets. Ensure the fire is completely out when finished.
